headline: A 2017 executive order directing federal agencies on how they treat free speech and religious freedom.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to protect free speech and religious freedom when they make and enforce rules. Only the title was provided, so the specific instructions to agencies are not described here. Executive orders guide how the government acts but cannot change laws passed by Congress.

who_it_affects.group: Religious organizations and people of faith
who_it_affects.how: Federal agencies are directed to consider religious freedom when applying rules that affect them.
Agencies must follow the order's direction when writing and enforcing rules related to speech and religion.
